items.label: Utilize Your Outdoor Area
items.value: Devoko outdoor couch can easily meet your needs to spend leisure time in your patio, porch, balcony, poolside and other outdoor space with a comfortable sitting or lying experience.

items.label: Sturdy Acacia Wood Frame
items.value: Crafted with a stable solid acacia wood frame, outdoor sofa is built to withstand outdoor elements and provide better load bearing. The wood is coated with water-based paint to prevent decay. The sturdy construction supports long-time serve life, making it a reliable choice for outdoor use.

items.label: Cozy Sitting
items.value: The patio couch can adjust 3 positions with soft thicken cushions, which can support your body in a comfortable posture and provide comfortable sitting experience.You can sit on the couch to read or lean back on the chair to watch a movie or just take a nap on the daybed.

items.label: Easy Installation
items.value: Devoko outdoor daybed is designed to be easy to assemble, allowing you to set it up in just a few short steps. A lady can finish Installation in less than half an hour. No complicated tools or lengthy instructions required.

items.label: Removable Thicken Pillows
items.value: Devoko outdoor couch features a high-density sponge with 2.75-inch thick cushions that provide great comfort and relaxation.The pillows are designed with ropes to secure them and provide a cozy and enjoyable lounging experience.

items.label: Flexible Transformation
items.value: This outdoor loveseat offers flexible transformation options. It’s designed to be easily converted from a couch to leisure lounge chair and relaxing daybed. You can choose base on your needs and preferences.
